title: CPU Saturation in Analytics Service Due to Unbounded Recursion
description: A deployment introduced unbounded recursion in the analytics query builder for a specific edge case (deeply nested JSON filter). CPU spikes to 100% on all pods, causing request timeouts.
initial_symptoms: Analytics service CPU at 100% on all pods
Thread dumps show recursive call stack
Kubernetes HPA scaling up pods but not helping

evidence_catalog.summary: Analytics service CPU usage at 100% across all pods since 10:00 UTC
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT avg(container_cpu_percent) FROM container_metrics WHERE service='analytics-service'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate CPU saturation metrics

evidence_catalog.summary: Thread dump shows 200+ threads stuck in QueryBuilder.buildFilter() recursive calls (depth > 10000)
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM thread_dumps WHERE service='analytics-service' AND stack LIKE '%buildFilter%'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate thread dump showing deep recursion
